commit_message: Complete ADR0131 governed runtime and session workspaces
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0131 governed runtime and session workspaces
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebuilds the ADR0131 first-release implementation on current main. Preserves governed AgentRun/AgentEvent evidence, managed Editor Play and frame capture, bounded persisted history, safe idempotent code apply, and adds session-scoped persistent code workspaces with restart-safe baseline provenance and run-level code checkpoints. The test-only fresh-workspace helper is limited to test builds so affected Clippy remains warning-free.

The change keeps semantic authoring on the project-scoped Editor MCP endpoint, preserves current main changes, and does not modify Dispatcher infrastructure or ADR0133 remote semantics.
